images.prompt: Flat vector government-agency seal insignia. A circular official seal centered on the canvas. Inside the seal ring: a long submarine sandwich on a split oval hoagie roll, layered with deli meat and lettuce, tapering to a point at the right end so the whole sandwich reads as a rightward arrow. It is a sub sandwich, NOT a hot dog, no sausage, no wiener, no mustard zigzag. Flanking it, a symmetrical golden laurel wreath of two curved branches. Beneath it, a golden ribbon bar carrying five stars. Colours: bright green and golden yellow on a flat institutional beige field. Crisp bureaucratic vector line work, federal-department styling, perfectly symmetrical, high contrast. Absolutely no floating white arrow, no cursor shape, no pointer graphic anywhere. Full-bleed square: the background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: SUBTERRANEAN SANDWICH AUTHORITY, in small clean uppercase letters curving around the inside of the seal ring.

Cinematic wide interior of a government-office sandwich counter, deserted. Institutional beige tile walls and floor, a long scratched acrylic sneeze guard running the width of the frame over stainless steel bins of shredded lettuce and pressed deli meat, a chrome take-a-number dispenser mounted on a post, a maze of black retractable queue ropes coiling toward the counter, a wall of blank laminated notices in plastic sleeves, worn linoleum. Flat cold overhead fluorescent tube light, no shadow drama, bureaucratic and slightly green, unflattering and honest. Camera: 24mm wide angle, eye level, deep focus, symmetrical one-point perspective, muted desaturated palette of beige, green and dull steel. Deadpan hyperreal realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
